name: Gluten-Free Rhubarb Pie With Sorghum Crust

ingredients.name: butter, chilled and cut into 6 pieces

instructions.primary_message: For the Crust: In bowl of food processor, combine sorghum flour, sweet rice flour, tapioca starch, granulated sugar and salt. Pulse to combine. Add butter. Pulse to combine until no large pieces of butter remain and mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs, about 8 to 10 one-second pulses. Add egg. Pulse to combine. Add one tablespoon water. Pulse until dough forms. If dough is dry, add remaining tablespoon water.
Turn dough out onto lightly white rice floured counter. Pat into a 10-cm round and wrap tightly in plastic wrap. Chill at least two hours or up to overnight.

For the Filling: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Lightly grease 25-cm pie plate and set aside. Remove dough from refrigerator. Allow it to sit on the counter for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in large bowl, rub together the cornstarch and granulated sugar. Add rhubarb and lemon juice. Stir to combine.

To Assemble: Place dough onto an 16 1/2- by 32-cm piece of parchment. Generously white rice flour top of dough. Roll dough into an approximate 36-cm circle. Invert 25-cm pie plate onto center of dough. Slide your hand (between counter and parchment paper) under the parchment paper. In one swift motion, flip dough into pan. Dough will overhang pan. Carefully peel parchment away from dough.
Pile filling into the center of the pan. Fold dough edges onto filling. Bake until crust is golden brown and filling bubbles, about 30 minutes. Remove and allow pie to cool in pan.

description: A gluten-free pie crust filled with rhubarb that can easily be made 100% vegan.
notes: Total time, including resting: 3 hr 45 min to 13 hr 45 min.
author: Elizabeth Barbone
